newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling Motors 1996 net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling Motors 1996 net profit soars.

text.p: Year ended December 31, 1996, (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures):
Earnings per share 0.06 yuan vs 0.01 yuan
Net assets per share 1.94 yuan vs 1.88 yuan
Company name: Jiangling Motors Corporation Ltd.

Note: The results, published in an annual report in the China Securities newspaper on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards except for the net profit figures which were based on international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profit of 43.36 million yuan for 1996 against 7.73 million in 1995.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a forthcoming meeting, the annual report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
